content.summary: Early-career business graduate combining structured research, practical operations support, and clear stakeholder communication through internships, university projects, and community leadership.

experience.title: Graduate Operations Intern
bullets: Analyzed weekly order and service data to identify three process changes that reduced unresolved requests by 21%.
Prepared concise performance summaries for a 12-person operations team, improving weekly review consistency.
Coordinated customer follow-up records for 260 accounts with 98% completeness.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Collected and cleaned survey data from 180 small-business respondents for a local market-access study.
Presented findings that informed a student enterprise support programme.
